gloss: stocking up; keeping a supply on hand

definitions.gloss: stocking up in advance; a stock kept on hand
definitions.explanation: Buying everyday items before they are needed so that a supply is always available, or the supply itself. Used of household staples such as rice, detergent, and toilet paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{買|か}い{置|お}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{買|か}い{置|お}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おいて⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: I'm glad I stocked up beforehand.

examples.japanese: {買|か}い{置|お}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰り：01275_kaeri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}って→寄る：02440_yoru⟧きます。
examples.english: We're out of our stock, so I'll stop by the supermarket on the way home.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy) + ⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (to leave in place). Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {買|か}い{置|お}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {買|か}い{置|お}き⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おく: to buy some to keep on hand
- {買|か}い{置|お}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a stock of something
- {買|か}い{置|お}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: to run out of one's stock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買|か}いだめ→買いだめ：08047_kaidame⟧: hoarding — larger quantities, often driven by anxiety about shortages
- ⟦{買|か}い{足|た}す→買い足す：30283_kaitasu⟧: to buy more — restocking after running short, the opposite timing
- ⟦{備蓄|びちく}→備蓄：07589_bichiku⟧: stockpile — formal, about emergency or national reserves
